content:
nina: hitting a surge of fncall schema rejects on the strict-canary for payments-route. console fills with red badges and customers emailed SE.

rahul: breakdown? parse vs shape vs enum?

nina: mostly shape (array vs object) and missing required fields. sample: {"tool":"get_tx","status":"declined","reason":"missing:transaction_id","raw":"[{\"id\":123}]"} 

claire: suggested changes: 1) add top-level meta.validation with outcome in [accepted,declined,coerced,fallback] and reason tag 2) add fncall_trace_id to link retries 3) default redact sampled raw payloads, allow opt-in per-route to store full traces encrypted.

rahul: billing: only bill when outcome==accepted or outcome==fallback. declines non-billable. notify finance.

audit-bot: created ticket AUDIT-918 for sample access logging.

nina: telemetry: emit validation.decline_rate.by_route and a sampled_payloads counter. UX: show strict vs permissive decline rates side-by-side and a revert CTA when strict rise > 0.5%.

claire: plan: PR to add meta fields + scrubber + trace id, UX mock for console, billing doc for finance/legal. sync tomorrow 11am.
